cards.text:
侦查小队
阵营规则
侦查前锋
星际战士侦察兵的基本职责是作为其所属打击
部队的前锋对敌人布置陷阱，骚扰巡逻队，
收集情报并侦查地形，为战团的突袭部队做
好准备。
在部署特工阶段结束时，您可以选择并结算至多
六个侦查前锋选项。每个选项的括号内都有一个
数字，代表着您可以在本场战斗中选择并结算该
选项的最大次数。例如，您的六个选择可以是转
移（2），绊索警报（1），饵雷陷阱（1）和分
散注意（1）。若双方玩家都拥有本规则，则交
替结算，从拥有先手的玩家开始。
侦查前锋选项将在单独的卡片中描述
cards.text_en:
SCOUT SQUAD
FACTION RULE
FORWARD SCOUTING
Central to the role of Space Marine Scouts is ranging
ahead of the strike force they are attached to, spending
extensive periods laying traps for the foe, harassing
enemy patrols, gathering intelligence and reconnoitring
the ground in preparation for the Chapter’s
assault force.
At the end of the Set Up Operatives step, you can
select and resolve up to six Forward Scouting
options. Each option has a number in brackets,
which is the maximum number of times you can
select and resolve it for the battle. For example,
your six selections could be Reposition (2), Trip
Alarm (1), Booby Trap (1) and Diversion (1). If
both players have this rule, alternate resolving
selection by selection, starting with the player
with initiative.
FORWARD SCOUTING OPTIONS ARE PRESENTED
ON THEIR OWN CARDS

cards.text:
侦查小队
阵营规则
侦查前锋
重新部署 (1)
改变己方三分之一数量特工的部署（向上取整）。
转移 (2)
完全位于己方降落区内的一名己方特工可执行一
次无消耗的转移行动，但它必须在完全位于己方
降落区 3" 内的位置结束那次移动。
绊索警报 (2)
将一枚己方绊索警报标识放置在距离敌方降落区
6" 以外的位置。在第一个和第二个转折点中，当
一名己方侦察小队特工对位于那个标识 2" 内的
一名敌方特工进行射击时，其远程武器获得
“追踪”武器规则。在第三个战略阶段的就绪步
骤中，将那个标识移除。
cards.text_en:
SCOUT SQUAD
FACTION RULE
FORWARD SCOUTING
Redeploy (1)
Change the set up of one third of your operatives
(rounding up).
Reposition (2)
Perform a free Reposition action with one friendly
operative that’s wholly within your drop zone.
It must end that move wholly within 3" of your
drop zone.
Trip Alarm (2)
Place one of your Trip Alarm markers more than
6" from your opponent’s drop zone. During
the first and second turning point, whenever a
friendly SCOUT SQUAD operative is shooting an
enemy operative that’s within 2" of that marker,
that friendly operative’s ranged weapons have the
Seek weapon rule. In the Ready step of the third
Strategy phase, remove that marker.

cards.text:
侦查小队
阵营规则
侦查前锋
饵雷陷阱 (1)
将一枚己方饵雷陷阱标识放置在距离敌方降落区
6" 外且距离其他标识、访问点，以及可穿越地
形 2" 以外的位置。当您的饵雷陷阱标识首次位
于一名敌方特工的控制范围内时，移除标识，
并对那名特工造成 2D3 点伤害。如果它没有残
废，中断它的行动（如果有），即使行动效果还
未满足。如果它不能被放置，则移动最小距离以
放置。
战术移动（1） (1)
每场战斗限两次。战略计划。选择一名己方特
工。直到那名特工的下一次激活结束前，其 APL
属性增加 1 点。
cards.text_en:
SCOUT SQUAD
FACTION RULE
FORWARD SCOUTING
Booby Trap (1)
Place one of your Booby Trap markers more than
6" from your opponent’s drop zone and more
than 2" from other markers, access points and
Accessible terrain. The first time your Booby
Trap marker is within an enemy operative’s
control range, remove that marker and inflict 2D3
damage on that operative; if it isn’t incapacitated,
end its action (if any), even if that action’s effects
aren’t fulfilled. If it cannot be placed, move it the
minimum amount to do so.
Tactical Manoeuvre (1)
Twice per battle STRATEGIC GAMBIT. Select
one friendly operative. Until the end of that
operative’s next activation, add 1 to its APL stat.

cards.text:
侦查小队
阵营规则
侦查前锋
分散注意 (1)
每场战斗限一次的战略计划。选择一名杀戮区边
缘 6" 内的敌方特工。直到那名特工下一次激活
结束前，将其 APL 减去 1 点。
制定计划 (1)
己方获得 1 点指挥点数。
指定目标 (1)
选择一名敌方特工获得一枚己方目标指示物。每
当己方侦察小队特工对您放置了己方目标指示
物的敌方特工进行射击，近战或反击时，您便可
以重掷一枚己方的攻击骰。
窥察 (1)
仅限认证行动。您的对手必须揭示其选择的战术
行动。
cards.text_en:
SCOUT SQUAD
FACTION RULE
FORWARD SCOUTING
Diversion (1)
Once per battle STRATEGIC GAMBIT. Select one
enemy operative within 6" of a killzone edge.
Until the end of that operative’s next activation,
subtract 1 from its APL stat.
Devise Plan (1)
You gain 1CP.
Designate Target (1)
Select one enemy operative to gain one of your
Target tokens. Whenever a friendly SCOUT
SQUAD operative is shooting against, fighting
against or retaliating against an enemy operative
that has one of your Target tokens, you can re-roll
one of your attack dice.
Spy (1)
Approved Ops only. Your opponent must reveal
their selected tac op.

侦查小队
战略计谋
游击交战
星际战士侦察兵知晓如何利用地形为自己获
取优势，能够在敌方杀伤范围内移动而不被
注意。

cards.text_en:
SCOUT SQUAD
STRATEGY PLOY
GUERRILLA ENGAGEMENT
Space Marine Scouts learn to use terrain to their
advantage, preventing the enemy from getting a bead on
them as they move within killing range.
Whenever an enemy operative is shooting a
friendly SCOUT SQUAD operative, if that friendly
operative is in cover and more than 6" from
enemy operatives it’s visible to, you can re-roll
one of your defence dice.

cards.text:
侦查小队
战略计谋
伏击
侦察小队在接近敌方射程时保持隐匿，并在精
心选择目标后进行攻击。
若一名己方侦察小队特工的命令在激活开始时
从隐匿转变为交战，或这名特工在激活开始时
对敌方特工不可见，那么每当它在那次激活中
进行射击或近战时：
• 其武器获得“平衡”武器规则。
• 若目标进入待机，则其武器获得“无休”武
器规则作为替代。
cards.text_en:
SCOUT SQUAD
STRATEGY PLOY
AMBUSH
Scout Squads utilise stealth to close within range
of their foes, carefully selecting their targets before
unleashing a devastating assault.
Whenever a friendly SCOUT SQUAD operative
is shooting or fighting during its activation, if its
order was changed from Conceal to Engage at
the start of that activation, or it wasn’t visible to
enemy operatives at the start of that activation:
• That friendly operative’s weapons have the
Balanced weapon rule.
• If the target is expended, that friendly
operative’s weapons have the Ceaseless
weapon rule instead.

cards.text:
侦查小队
战略计谋
灵活训练
星际战士新手和经验丰富的军士运用催眠灌输
了一系列灵活战术。再加上潜行训练，他们能
够智胜敌人，同时保持自身隐蔽。
您可以改变最多 D3 个位于敌方特工 4" 外的己
方侦察小队特工的命令。
cards.text_en:
SCOUT SQUAD
STRATEGY PLOY
ADAPTABLE TRAINING
Space Marine Neophytes and their experienced
Sergeants draw upon a host of versatile tactics
embedded through hypno-indoctrination. Coupled
with their stealth training, this enables them to
outmanoeuvre their foes while remaining out of reach.
You can change the order of up to D3 friendly
SCOUT SQUAD operatives that are more than 4"
from enemy operatives.

cards.text:
侦查小队
战略计谋
匿迹转移
星际战士侦察小队是一个极具机动性的单位，
往往能通过快速转移压倒敌人。
最多 D3 名拥有隐匿命令且位于敌方特工 4" 外
的己方侦察小队特工可以立即执行一次无消耗
的冲刺行动。您无法在第一个转折点中使用本
计谋。
cards.text_en:
SCOUT SQUAD
STRATEGY PLOY
STEALTH RELOCATION
Space Marine Scout Squads are highly mobile
units, shifting swiftly from cover to cover in order to
outmanoeuvre the foe.
Up to D3 friendly SCOUT SQUAD operatives that
have a Conceal order and are more than 4" from
enemy operatives can immediately perform a free
Dash action. You cannot use this ploy during the
first turning point.

cards.text:
侦查小队
交战计谋
阿斯塔特训练
星际战士战团是银河中最为精锐的战斗组织。
即便其中的新进者都能在使用武器时展现出无
与伦比的技艺。
在一名己方侦察小队特工激活时使用此交战计
谋。直到那个激活结束前，那名特工可以执行下
列选项之一：
• 执行两次近战行动。
• 执行两次射击行动，并且其中至少一次选择了
阿斯塔特霰弹枪，爆矢手枪或爆矢枪作为远程
武器。
• 使用重型爆矢枪，导弹发射器或狙击步枪执行
两次射击行动，但第二次行动必须消耗额外 1
点 AP。
cards.text_en:
SCOUT SQUAD
FIREFIGHT PLOY
ASTARTES TRAINING
Space Marine Chapters are amongst the galaxy’s most
elite fighting forces. Even their Neophytes wield their
weapons with peerless skill.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly SCOUT
SQUAD operative’s activation. Until the end
of that activation, that operative can do one of
the following:
• Perform two Fight actions.
• Perform two Shoot actions if an Astartes
shotgun, bolt pistol or boltgun is selected for at
least one of them.
• Perform two Shoot actions with a heavy bolter,
missile launcher or sniper rifle, but 1 additional
AP must be spent for the second action.

cards.text:
侦查小队
交战计谋
狂野生理
尽管星际战士侦察兵们尚未完成训练，但他们
已经拥有了和其他成熟战斗兄弟们相同的基因
强化恢复力。
在一名己方侦察小队特工激活时，在其执行一
次行动之前或之后使用此交战计谋。直到它的下
一次激活开始前，为其移动属性增加 1" 并且您
可以忽略受创对这名特工属性的任何修正（其中
包含了其武器属性）。
cards.text_en:
SCOUT SQUAD
FIREFIGHT PLOY
RAW PHYSIOLOGY
Though their training may not yet be complete, Space
Marine Scouts possess the same genetically augmented
resilience as their fully fledged battle-brothers.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly SCOUT
SQUAD operative’s activation, before or after
it performs an action. Until the start of its next
activation, add 1" to its Move stat and you can
ignore any changes to that operative’s stats from
being injured (including its weapons’ stats).

cards.text:
侦查小队
交战计谋
勇猛新进者
手术强化，教导和严酷训练为这些星际战士新
进者注入了与强大敌人战斗的信念和决心。
在一名己方侦察小队特工执行近战或射击行动
时，在进行任何重掷后使用此交战计谋。如果
它是当前转折点中第一个执行那次行动的己方
特工，或者那次行动中的敌方特工（如果涉及
多名敌方特工，则为主要目标）拥有的耐伤属
性高于那名己方侦察小队特工，那么您可以将
一个自己的普通成功作为关键成功进行保留。
cards.text_en:
SCOUT SQUAD
FIREFIGHT PLOY
EMBOLDENED ASPIRANT
Surgical enhancement, indoctrination and brutal
training instil within a Space Marine Neophyte the
confidence and determination to battle powerful foes.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly SCOUT
SQUAD operative performs the Shoot or
Fight action, after any re-rolls. If it’s the first
friendly operative to perform either of those
actions during this turning point, or if the
enemy operative in that action (primary target,
if relevant) has a higher Wounds stat than that
friendly SCOUT SQUAD operative, you can
retain one of your normal successes as a critical
success instead.

cards.text:
侦查小队
交战计谋
隐蔽位置
星际战士侦察兵擅长伪装自己，能在数小时乃
至数日的待命中找到绝佳时机然后发起突袭。
在一名己方侦察小队特工激活时使用此交战计
谋。直到它的下一次激活开始前，若那名特工拥
有隐蔽命令并处于掩护中，便无法被选为有效
目标，本规则的优先度高于所有其他规则（例
如‘追踪’武器规则和制高点地形)，除非攻击
者位于特工的 2" 内。
cards.text_en:
SCOUT SQUAD
FIREFIGHT PLOY
COVERT POSITION
Space Marine Scouts excel at camouflaging themselves,
laying in wait for hours or even days at a time until they
identify the perfect moment to strike.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly SCOUT
SQUAD operative’s activation. Until the start
of its next activation, while that operative has
a Conceal order and is in cover, it cannot be
selected as a valid target, taking precedence over
all other rules (e.g. Seek, Vantage terrain) except
being within 2".

cards.text:
侦查小队
阵营装备
迷彩斗篷
迷彩斗篷使用了诸如变色织物这类能够操弄光
线的材料，能够让使用者融入周围地形。
当一名特工对一名己方侦察小队特工进行射击
时（狙击手除外），若您能够保留任意掩护豁
免，则您可以额外保留一个掩护豁免。但这无
法与制高点提供的掩护豁免相累加。
cards.text_en:
SCOUT SQUAD
FACTION EQUIPMENT
CAMO CLOAK
Crafted from light-manipulating materials such as
cameleoline, camo cloaks help the bearer blend into
surrounding terrain.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
SCOUT SQUAD operative (excluding SNIPER),
if you can retain any cover saves, you can retain
one additional cover save. This isn’t cumulative
with improved cover saves from Vantage terrain.

cards.text:
侦查小队
阵营装备
瞄准目镜
这些极为灵敏的多光谱瞄准目镜能够协助使用
者执行瞄准，使武器更为致命。
每个转折点最多两次，当一名己方侦察小队特
工在执行射击行动中选择了一个有效目标后，
您可以使用这个规则。若此，直到那个行动结
束前，其远程武器获得“致命 5+”和“集中”
武器规则。
cards.text_en:
SCOUT SQUAD
FACTION EQUIPMENT
TARGETING OCULARS
These highly sensitive multispectral targeting visors
serve to aid the bearer’s aim, rendering their weapons
even more lethal.
Up to twice per turning point, when a friendly
SCOUT SQUAD operative is performing the
Shoot action and you’re selecting a valid target,
you can use this rule. If you do, until the end
of that action, that friendly operative’s ranged
weapons have the Lethal 5+ and Saturate
weapon rules.

cards.text:
侦查小队
阵营装备
格斗刀
星际战士新进者使用一系列短刃近战武器，他
们很善于用这些武器对敌人造成致命伤害。
己方侦察小队特工获得以下近战武器。请注
意，一些特工已经拥有这件武器并且它们拥有
更佳的数据；在这种情况下，使用更好的那个
版本。
名称攻击命中伤害
格斗刀 3 3+ 4/5
cards.text_en:
SCOUT SQUAD
FACTION EQUIPMENT
COMBAT BLADES
Space Marine Neophytes wield a variety of short-bladed
melee weapons, demonstrating lethal proficiency with
them all.
Friendly SCOUT SQUAD operatives have
the following melee weapon. Note that some
operatives already have this weapon but
with better stats; in that instance, use the
better version.
NAME ATK HIT DMG
Combat blade 3 3+ 4/5

cards.text:
侦查小队
阵营装备
战术通讯链路
侦查军士架起了战术通讯链路，指引下属进行
狂暴而精准的攻击。
每个转折点限一次，如果一个己方军士特工位
于杀戮区，您可以消耗 0CP 使用阿斯塔特训练
或勇猛新进者交战计谋。
cards.text_en:
SCOUT SQUAD
FACTION EQUIPMENT
TACTICAL VOX-LINK
The Scout Sergeant maintains a constant vox-link with
the aspirants in his charge, directing their aggression
with deadly precision.
Once per turning point, you can use the Astartes
Training or Emboldened Aspirant firefight ploy
for 0CP if a friendly SERGEANT operative is in
the killzone.
